newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Andean agency to loan Ecuador $1 bln by end 1998.
newsitem.headline: Andean agency to loan Ecuador $1 bln by end 1998.

text.p: The Andean Development Corp (CAF) announced Monday it will provide Ecuador with up to $1 billion in loans this year and next.

"We have the utmost willingness to have loans in the order of $1 billion for 1997 and 1998," said Enrique Garcia, president of the CAF, financial arm of the Andean Pact that groups Ecuador with Colombia, Venezuela, Peru and Bolivia.
"This means more investment. Investment means growth and that means jobs," he said. ((-- Quito newsroom, 5932 258-433))
